name: Statement
summary: One big line filling the frame, with an optional eyebrow: a hook, a punchline or a turn in the story.
usage: <Statement eyebrow="Agents everywhere" text="Five agents running." accent="One needs you." />

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: A small label above the headline.

props.name: text
props.doc: The line, before its accent phrase.

props.name: accent
props.doc: The phrase set in the style's accent way, after the text.

props.name: effect
props.doc: How the words come in; the style's own if not set.

props.name: exit
props.doc: Frame it starts to leave; it stays to the end if not set.

name: Metric
summary: A number that counts up with what it counts under it; real numbers only.
usage: <Metric value={12} label="agents in one window" note="and counting" />

props.name: value
props.doc: The number it counts up to.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the number counts, under it.

props.name: prefix
props.doc: Text before the number, such as `$`.

props.name: suffix
props.doc: Text after the number, such as `%` or `k`.

props.name: decimals
props.doc: Decimal places to show; 0 if not set.

props.name: note
props.doc: A small line under the label, such as a source or a date.

name: Features
summary: Three to six features as cards with icons, coming in one after another: what the product does.
usage: <Features title="Everything in" accent="one window." items={[{icon: Columns3, title: 'Split panes', text: 'Grouped by project'}]} />

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: A small label above the headline.

props.name: title
props.doc: The headline, before its accent phrase.

props.name: accent
props.doc: The phrase set in the style's accent way, after the title.

props.name: items
props.type: { icon: LucideIcon; title: string; text?: string; }[]
props.doc: Three to six features, one card each.

name: Quote
summary: A testimonial with who said it, an initials avatar and their role; real quotes only, with permission.
usage: <Quote quote="I stopped tabbing through terminals." accent="Now they come to me." name="Ada Okafor" role="Design lead" />

props.name: quote
props.doc: What they said, before its accent phrase.

props.name: accent
props.doc: The phrase set in the style's accent way, after the quote.

props.name: name
props.doc: Who said it; their initials make the avatar.

props.name: role
props.doc: Their role and company, under the name.

name: Compare
summary: Before and after: the old way struck through, the product's way ticked, side by side or stacked.
usage: <Compare title="Stop checking" accent="every tab." before={{title: 'Before', items: ['Tab through every terminal']}} after={{title: 'After', items: ['Every agent in one view']}} />

props.name: title
props.doc: The headline, before its accent phrase.

props.name: accent
props.doc: The phrase set in the style's accent way, after the title.

props.name: before
props.doc: The old way: a heading and its items, struck through.

props.name: after
props.doc: The product's way: a heading and its items, ticked.

name: Steps
summary: Numbered steps joined by a line that draws from one to the next: how it works.
usage: <Steps title="How it" accent="works." steps={['Open a group', 'Start your agents', 'Get pinged when one asks']} />

props.name: title
props.doc: The headline, before its accent phrase.

props.name: accent
props.doc: The phrase set in the style's accent way, after the title.

props.name: steps
props.doc: The steps in order, one short line each.

name: LogoReveal
summary: The logo arriving (pop, iris, slide or focus), then the name and a tagline under it.
usage: <LogoReveal kind="pop" tagline="Run agents in parallel." accent="All in one place." />

props.name: kind
props.doc: How the logo arrives: `pop`, `iris`, `slide` or `focus`; `pop` if not set.

props.name: tagline
props.doc: A line under the name, before its accent phrase.

props.name: accent
props.doc: The phrase set in the style's accent way, after the tagline.

props.name: logo
props.doc: An image in public/; the brand's logo if not set.

props.name: name
props.doc: The name under the logo; the brand's name if not set.

name: EndCard
summary: The ask, big and held: logo and name, one line, a button with a glint and the URL.
usage: <EndCard line="Your agents keep working." accent="Even when you walk away." button="Download free" url="example.com" />

props.name: line
props.doc: One line under the name, before its accent phrase.

props.name: accent
props.doc: The phrase set in the style's accent way, after the line.

props.name: button
props.doc: The button's words; `Get started` if not set.

props.name: url
props.doc: Where to go, under the button; the brand's URL if not set.

name: Lineup
summary: People as portrait cards with initials or photos, coming in one after another: speakers, a team, hosts.
usage: <Lineup title="Meet the" accent="speakers." people={[{name: 'Ada Okafor', role: 'Design lead'}, {name: 'Ravi Menon', role: 'Founder'}]} />

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: A small label above the headline.

props.name: title
props.doc: The headline, before its accent phrase.

props.name: accent
props.doc: The phrase set in the style's accent way, after the title.

props.name: people
props.type: { name: string; role?: string; initials?: string; image?: string; }[]
props.doc: Two to eight people, one card each.

name: Agenda
summary: A schedule row by row with times, then a highlight slides to the featured row: an event or a launch day.
usage: <Agenda title="Day one" date="Thu · Oct 24" items={[{time: '09:30', title: 'Keynote', who: 'Ravi Menon'}]} highlight={0} />

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: A small label above the headline.

props.name: title
props.doc: The headline, before its accent phrase.

props.name: accent
props.doc: The phrase set in the style's accent way, after the title.

props.name: date
props.doc: The day it happens, shown with the headline.

props.name: items
props.type: { time: string; title: string; who?: string; }[]
props.doc: The schedule, one row each.

props.name: highlight
props.doc: The row to highlight, counted from 0; none if not set.

name: Countdown
summary: Days, hours, minutes and seconds ticking down for real, each digit rolling: a launch, an event, a sale ending.
usage: <Countdown title="Doors open" accent="soon." to="Oct 24 · 9:00 AM" from={{days: 12, hours: 4, minutes: 32, seconds: 9}} />

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: A small label above the headline.

props.name: title
props.doc: The headline, before its accent phrase.

props.name: accent
props.doc: The phrase set in the style's accent way, after the title.

props.name: to
props.doc: The date and time it counts down to, as it should read.

props.name: from
props.type: { days: number; hours: number; minutes: number; seconds: number; }
props.doc: How long is left when the scene starts; it ticks down in real time.

name: Changelog
summary: A version badge, then the changes landing one by one tagged New, Improved or Fixed: release notes.
usage: <Changelog version="v2.4" title="What's" accent="new." items={[{tag: 'New', text: 'Offline mode'}, {tag: 'Fixed', text: 'Sync on flaky connections'}]} />

props.name: version
props.doc: The release, in the badge, such as `v2.4`.

props.name: title
props.doc: The headline, before its accent phrase.

props.name: accent
props.doc: The phrase set in the style's accent way, after the title.

props.name: items
props.doc: The changes, one row each.

name: Timeline
summary: Milestones on a line that draws from one to the next, the last one marked: company history or a year in review.
usage: <Timeline title="How we" accent="got here." items={[{when: '2023', what: 'Two people, one idea'}, {when: '2026', what: 'Series A'}]} />

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: A small label above the headline.

props.name: title
props.doc: The headline, before its accent phrase.

props.name: accent
props.doc: The phrase set in the style's accent way, after the title.

props.name: items
props.doc: The milestones in order; the last one is marked.

name: List
summary: Labels with dotted leaders to values and an optional detail line: a menu, open roles, prices.
usage: <List title="Today's" accent="menu." items={[{label: 'Flat white', detail: 'Oat or whole', value: '$4.50'}]} />

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: A small label above the headline.

props.name: title
props.doc: The headline, before its accent phrase.

props.name: accent
props.doc: The phrase set in the style's accent way, after the title.

props.name: items
props.type: { label: string; detail?: string; value?: string; }[]
props.doc: The rows.

name: Announcement
summary: Big news: the headline lands with a glint and a drawn stroke under it, then a line of detail.
usage: <Announcement eyebrow="Big news" text="We raised $18M" accent="to build what's next." detail="Series A" />

props.name: eyebrow
props.doc: A small label above the headline.

props.name: text
props.doc: The news, before its accent phrase.

props.name: accent
props.doc: The phrase set in the style's accent way, after the text.

props.name: detail
props.doc: A line of detail under it.

props.name: size
props.doc: The headline's font size in px; sized to the frame if not set.

name: Kinetic
summary: A headline that comes in word by word or letter by letter the style's way, with its accent phrase marked as it lands.
usage: <Kinetic text="Approve it" accent="from your phone." start={10} exit={80} />

props.name: text
props.doc: The words, before the accent phrase.

props.name: accent
props.doc: The phrase set in the style's accent way.

props.name: effect
props.doc: How the words come in; the style's own if not set.

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame it starts on, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: stagger
props.doc: Frames between one word (or letter) starting and the next; the effect's own if not set.

props.name: exit
props.doc: Frame it starts to leave; it stays to the end if not set.

props.name: mark
props.doc: What's drawn behind the accent phrase; the style's own if not set.

props.name: align
props.doc: Left-aligned or centred (default left).

props.name: style
props.doc: CSS merged over the headline style: font size, colour, max width.

name: Mark
summary: Draws a highlighter, block, pill, underline, circle, strike or box on any inline words at a given frame.

props.name: kind
props.doc: Which mark: marker, block, pill, underline, circle, strike or box.

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame its mark starts to draw, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: color
props.doc: Its colour; the style's accent if not set (the alert colour for a strike).

props.name: children
props.doc: The words, number or name to mark.

name: Cycle
summary: One slot in a line whose word changes every few frames, sliding the old word out and the new one in.

props.name: words
props.doc: The words it cycles through, in order; it loops.

props.name: every
props.doc: Frames each word holds before the next comes in; 45 times the style's pace if not set.

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame it starts on, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: style
props.doc: CSS merged over the headline and accent style: font size, colour.

name: Counter
summary: A number counting up or down with easing, thousands separators and tabular figures, at a fixed width.

props.name: to
props.doc: The number it counts to.

props.name: from
props.doc: The number it counts from (default 0).

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame it starts on, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: frames
props.doc: Frames the count takes; 50 times the style's pace if not set.

props.name: decimals
props.doc: Digits after the decimal point (default 0).

props.name: prefix
props.doc: Text before the number, like $.

props.name: suffix
props.doc: Text after the number, like + or %.

props.name: style
props.doc: CSS merged over the headline style: font size, colour.

name: Draw
summary: An SVG path that draws itself on, and off again: a hand-drawn underline, a scribble, a route.

props.name: d
props.doc: The SVG path to draw, in a `width` × `height` box.

props.name: width
props.doc: Its width in px: the box `d` is drawn in.

props.name: height
props.doc: Its height in px: the box `d` is drawn in.

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame it starts on, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: frames
props.doc: Frames the line takes to draw (default 36).

props.name: exit
props.doc: Frame it starts to undraw; it stays to the end if not set.

props.name: color
props.doc: Its colour; the style's accent if not set.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.doc: Line width in px (default 6).

props.name: stretch
props.doc: Let `style` size the box to any width and height, stretching the path: for an underline as wide as its word.

props.name: style
props.doc: CSS for the SVG, to place or size it.

name: Arrow
summary: A curved, hand-drawn arrow that draws itself from one point to another, its head landing last.

props.name: from
props.doc: Where it starts, in px of its parent.

props.name: to
props.doc: Where the head lands, in px of its parent.

props.name: bend
props.doc: How much it curves: 0 is straight, more bows it to the left of travel, less to the right (default 0.25).

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame it starts on, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: frames
props.doc: Frames the line takes to draw (default 28).

props.name: exit
props.doc: Frame it starts to leave; it stays to the end if not set.

props.name: color
props.doc: Its colour; the style's accent if not set.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.doc: Line width in px (default 6).

props.name: head
props.doc: Length of the head's two strokes in px (default 26).

name: Ring
summary: A ring that fills to a percentage, the number counting up in its middle.

props.name: value
props.doc: The percentage it fills to, 0 to 100.

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame it starts on, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: frames
props.doc: Frames the ring takes to fill (default 60).

props.name: size
props.doc: Its width and height in px (default 320).

props.name: thickness
props.doc: Width of the ring in px; 7.5% of `size` if not set.

props.name: label
props.doc: Words under the number.

props.name: suffix
props.doc: After the number (default '%').

props.name: color
props.doc: Its colour; the style's accent if not set.

props.name: exit
props.doc: Frame it starts to leave; it stays to the end if not set.

name: Bars
summary: A bar chart whose bars grow in one after another, values counting up, one bar highlighted.

props.name: data
props.doc: The bars, in order: a label and a value each.

props.name: highlight
props.doc: Index of the bar drawn in the accent.

props.name: across
props.doc: Lay the bars on their side with the labels on the left: for named categories, and for many bars in a tall frame.

props.name: width
props.doc: Its width in px (default 900).

props.name: height
props.doc: Its height in px (default 480).

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame it starts on, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: stagger
props.doc: Frames between one bar starting to grow and the next (default 5).

props.name: max
props.doc: The value a full bar stands for; the largest value if not set.

props.name: format
props.doc: How a value is written (default a whole number with thousands separators).

props.name: exit
props.doc: Frame it starts to leave; it stays to the end if not set.

name: LineChart
summary: A line chart that draws across, its area filling in and a dot riding the head with the current value.

props.name: values
props.doc: The points, left to right.

props.name: labels
props.doc: Labels under the points, one per value.

props.name: width
props.doc: Its width in px (default 960).

props.name: height
props.doc: Its height in px (default 440).

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame it starts on, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: frames
props.doc: Frames the line takes to draw across (default 70).

props.name: min
props.doc: The value at the bottom (default 0).

props.name: max
props.doc: The value at the top; 12% above the largest value if not set.

props.name: color
props.doc: Its colour; the style's accent if not set.

props.name: format
props.doc: How the value at the line's head is written (default a whole number with thousands separators).

props.name: exit
props.doc: Frame it starts to leave; it stays to the end if not set.

name: Stat
summary: A big number counting up, its label under it, with an optional delta chip.

props.name: value
props.doc: The number it counts up to.

props.name: label
props.doc: Words under the number.

props.name: prefix
props.doc: Before the number, like '$'.

props.name: suffix
props.doc: After the number, like '%' or 'k'.

props.name: decimals
props.doc: Decimal places shown (default 0).

props.name: delta
props.doc: A small chip beside the number once the count lands, like '+38%'.

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame it starts on, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: frames
props.doc: Frames the count takes (default 50).

props.name: size
props.doc: Size of the number in px; twice the style's headline size if not set.

props.name: align
props.doc: 'center' puts the label under the middle of the number, 'left' lines both up on the left (default 'center').

props.name: exit
props.doc: Frame it starts to leave; it stays to the end if not set.

name: Progress
summary: A progress bar filling to a percentage, with its label and percentage above it.

props.name: value
props.doc: The percentage it fills to; at 100 it says Done.

props.name: label
props.doc: Words above the bar, on the left.

props.name: width
props.doc: Its width in px (default 760).

props.name: thickness
props.doc: Height of the bar in px (default 16).

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame it starts on, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: frames
props.doc: Frames the bar takes to fill (default 50).

props.name: exit
props.doc: Frame it starts to leave; it stays to the end if not set.

name: Checklist
summary: Items ticking off one by one: each box fills and its check draws in.
usage: <Checklist items={['Tests pass', 'Preview deployed', 'Ready to merge']} start={6} />

props.name: items
props.doc: The lines to tick off, in order.

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame it starts on, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: stagger
props.doc: Frames between one item ticking and the next (default 16).

props.name: size
props.doc: Size of the text in px (default 34).

props.name: exit
props.doc: Frame it starts to leave; it stays to the end if not set.

name: Burst
summary: Confetti bursting from a point and falling away under gravity: a success moment.

props.name: x
props.doc: Where it bursts from, in px of its parent.

props.name: y
props.doc: Where it bursts from, in px of its parent.

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame it bursts on, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: count
props.doc: How many pieces of confetti (default 80).

props.name: power
props.doc: How big and far it bursts; 1 is normal (default 1).

props.name: seed
props.doc: Changes the pattern, so two bursts don't match (default 'burst').

props.name: colors
props.doc: Colours of the confetti; the accent, the alert colour, a light accent and the ink if not set.

name: Shine
summary: A glint of light sweeping across its children, once or on a loop.

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame the first glint starts on, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: frames
props.doc: Frames one sweep takes (default 30).

props.name: every
props.doc: Sweep again every this many frames; just once if not set.

props.name: radius
props.doc: Corner radius of what it shines on, in px; the style's if not set.

props.name: color
props.doc: Colour of the glint (default a soft white).

props.name: children
props.doc: What it shines across: a button, a logo, a price.

name: Cursor
summary: A macOS pointer gliding through points, with a press and a ripple on clicks.
usage: <Cursor points={[{x: 1300, y: 760, at: 0}, {x: 900, y: 430, at: 30, click: true}]} />

props.name: points
props.doc: Where it goes: each point's `x` and `y` in px of its parent, the frame `at` it arrives there, and `click` to press there.

props.name: travel
props.doc: Frames it takes to move from one point to the next (default 22).

props.name: size
props.doc: Its size in px (default 40).

props.name: exit
props.doc: Frame it starts to leave; it stays to the end if not set.

props.name: light
props.doc: A white pointer with a dark edge, for dark footage; a black one if not set.

name: Keys
summary: Keyboard keys that pop in and press down one after another: a shortcut.

props.name: keys
props.doc: The keys, in the order they go down: '⌘', 'Shift', 'K'.

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame it starts on, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: stagger
props.doc: Frames between one key going down and the next (default 8).

props.name: hold
props.doc: Frames the keys stay down before they let go (default 30).

props.name: size
props.doc: Height of a key in px (default 140).

props.name: exit
props.doc: Frame it starts to leave; it stays to the end if not set.

name: Spotlight
summary: Dims the whole frame except one rectangle, the hole tightening onto it.

props.name: rect
props.type: { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; }
props.doc: The part to light, in px of the frame: `x`, `y`, `width`, `height`.

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame it starts on, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: frames
props.doc: Frames the light takes to close in (default 26).

props.name: exit
props.doc: Frame it starts to leave; it stays to the end if not set.

props.name: dim
props.doc: How dark the rest of the frame gets, 0 to 1 (default 0.62).

props.name: pad
props.doc: Space left around `rect` in px (default 14).

props.name: radius
props.doc: Corner radius of the hole in px; the style's if not set.

props.name: ring
props.doc: Draw an accent outline round the hole (default true).

name: Toast
summary: A notification sliding in like macOS or iOS: app icon, name, time, title and body.
usage: <Toast title="Build passed" body="All 214 checks green on main" start={8} />

props.name: title
props.doc: The notification's title.

props.name: body
props.doc: A line under the title.

props.name: app
props.doc: The app's name; the brand's if not set.

props.name: time
props.doc: The time beside the app's name (default 'now').

props.name: icon
props.doc: A lucide icon on an accent tile, in place of the logo.

props.name: logo
props.doc: An image in public/ for the app's icon; the brand logo if not set.

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame it starts on, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: exit
props.doc: Frame it starts to leave; it stays to the end if not set.

props.name: width
props.doc: Its width in px (default 560).

props.name: from
props.doc: Where it slides in from: 'top' or 'right' (default 'top').

name: Chat
summary: A conversation: bubbles arriving one by one, theirs after typing dots, earlier ones pushed up.
usage: <Chat messages={[{from: 'them', text: 'Can you ship it tonight?', at: 20}, {from: 'me', text: 'Already merged.', at: 46}]} />

props.name: messages
props.doc: The bubbles, in order: who sent each (`from`: 'me' or 'them'), its `text`, and the frame `at` it lands.

props.name: width
props.doc: Its width in px (default 640).

props.name: size
props.doc: Size of the text in px (default 28).

props.name: typing
props.doc: Frames of typing dots before each of their messages (default 22).

props.name: exit
props.doc: Frame it starts to leave; it stays to the end if not set.

name: Badge
summary: A pill label that pops in with an icon or a live dot: New, Beta, Live.

props.name: text
props.doc: The words on it.

props.name: icon
props.doc: A lucide icon before the words.

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame it starts on, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: exit
props.doc: Frame it starts to leave; it stays to the end if not set.

props.name: tone
props.doc: How loud it is: 'soft', 'accent', 'card' or 'alert' (default 'soft').

props.name: size
props.doc: Size of the text in px; scaled to the format's headline if not set.

props.name: pulse
props.doc: Add a live dot that pulses.

name: Icon
summary: A lucide icon in a tinted tile that pops in, for feature grids.

props.name: icon
props.doc: The lucide icon (lucide.dev): `import {Zap} from 'lucide-react'`.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size of the tile in px (default 112).

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame it starts on, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: exit
props.doc: Frame it starts to leave; it stays to the end if not set.

props.name: tone
props.doc: The tile's fill: 'soft', 'accent' or 'card' (default 'soft').

name: Marquee
summary: A row of words or logos sliding past for ever, its ends fading out.

props.name: items
props.doc: What slides past: strings are set in the headline face; pass elements for logos.

props.name: loop
props.doc: Seconds one full loop takes (default 9).

props.name: gap
props.doc: Space between items in px; 70% of `size` if not set.

props.name: reverse
props.doc: Slide the other way.

props.name: size
props.doc: Size of the words in px; 1.1 times the style's headline size if not set.

props.name: color
props.doc: Colour of the words; the style's ink if not set.

props.name: start
props.doc: Frame it starts on, counted from the start of its scene (default 0).

props.name: separator
props.doc: Put an accent dot between items (default true).

props.name: width
props.doc: Its width, in px or any CSS width (default '100%').

name: Paper
summary: A card of warm paper with grain, fibres and an uneven edge that slides in and holds a drawing.

props.name: width
props.doc: Its width in px.

props.name: height

name: plain
summary: Just the style's page colour.

name: glow
summary: Soft lights in the accent drifting over faint hairlines.

name: grid
summary: A swiss column grid inside the safe margins, with a + at every other crossing.

name: dots
summary: A dot grid that drifts slowly and fades at the edges.

name: blobs
summary: Pastel cousins of the accent, drifting and changing shape.

name: scanlines
summary: A CRT: scanlines, a rolling band and dark corners.

name: grain
summary: Film grain that dances every frame, with a vignette.

name: aurora
summary: Ribbons of light in the accent swaying over a hairline grid.

name: beams
summary: Light falling from above in slow-swaying beams.

name: spotlight
summary: One soft breathing light from above, the corners in shadow.

name: cut
summary: A hard cut: the next scene replaces this one with no overlap.

name: fade
summary: A cross-fade between the two scenes.

name: dip
summary: The scene fades to the page colour, then the next one fades in from it.

name: slide
summary: The next scene slides in from the right on a spring, pushing this one out.

name: wipe
summary: A hard edge sweeps across from the right, revealing the next scene.

name: iris
summary: A circle opens from the middle onto the next scene.

name: clock
summary: A hand sweeps round like a clock, revealing the next scene.

name: flip
summary: The frame turns over like a card in 3D to show the next scene.

name: zoom
summary: Forward through the cut: this scene rushes past the camera and blurs, the next settles in.

name: whip
summary: A very fast push sideways with a motion smear at its peak.

name: bars
summary: Bars of the accent sweep in, cover the scene, then uncover the next one.

name: flash
summary: A cut hidden in a bright flash, with a little punch-in on the next scene.

name: glitch
summary: A few frames of digital breakup: torn slices and split colour channels.

name: zoomBlur
summary: A radial zoom blur through the cut. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: crossZoom
summary: Both scenes zoom and blur into each other. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: dreamyZoom
summary: A slow, rotating dreamy zoom into the next scene. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: filmBurn
summary: A warm film burn flares across the cut. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: crosswarp
summary: The scenes warp sideways into each other. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: ripple
summary: A water ripple spreads from the middle into the next scene. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: swap
summary: The two scenes swap places in perspective. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: bookFlip
summary: A page turns like a book onto the next scene. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: blurSlide
summary: A slide with a motion blur. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: linearBlur
summary: A directional blur carries one scene into the next. A WebGL shader: use it as an accent, and check every frame of the final render around it.

name: pushCut
summary: A push cut with a flash in the accent at the join.
